name: Blinded
summary: Can't see; auto-fails sight checks. Attacks against have advantage; its attacks have disadvantage.

name: Frightened
summary: Disadvantage on checks and attacks while the source of fear is in line of sight; can't willingly move closer to it.

name: Grappled
summary: Speed becomes 0; ends if the grappler is incapacitated or removed.

name: Paralyzed
summary: Incapacitated, can't move or speak; auto-fails STR and DEX saves; attacks against have advantage and any hit within 5 ft is a critical.

name: Poisoned
summary: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

name: Prone
summary: Can only crawl unless it stands. Disadvantage on attacks; melee attacks against have advantage, ranged have disadvantage.

name: Restrained
summary: Speed 0; attacks against have advantage; its attacks have disadvantage; disadvantage on DEX saves.

name: Stunned
summary: Incapacitated, can't move, can speak only falteringly; auto-fails STR and DEX saves; attacks against have advantage.

name: Unconscious
summary: Incapacitated, can't move or speak, drops what it holds, falls prone; auto-fails STR and DEX saves; attacks against have advantage and crit if within 5 ft.
